duplicateDialog.description: Provide a reason (FIR reference, affidavit details) for the duplicate.

tc.noDuplicates: No duplicates requested for this TC.

accessDenied.title: You can't view transfer certificates
accessDenied.description: Your role does not include access to transfer certificates. Ask your institute admin if you need it.

approve.title: Approve this TC?
approve.description: Once approved, the TC can be issued to the student.

issue.title: Issue this TC?
issue.description: The TC gets its serial number and the student is marked as transferred out. This can't be undone.

issueDuplicate.title: Issue this duplicate TC?
issueDuplicate.description: The duplicate gets the original's serial number with a -D suffix. The student's record is not changed. This can't be undone.
issueDuplicate.error: Could not issue the duplicate TC
